title: LLM Model Info (JSON, Record)
description: Information about a loaded LLM model including capabilities and parameters
documentation:
## Purpose
Describes a loaded LLM's structural properties and capabilities, including vocabulary size, maximum context length, embedding dimensions, and feature flags such as chat template and tool-use support.

## When to use
Retrieve this type when a cap or orchestrator needs to know model capabilities before issuing a generation request. It is the response to a `get_info` request in a [LLM Generation Request](https://capdag.com/browse/media:llm-generation-request;json;record).

## Notes
The `model_spec` and `vocab_size` fields are required. All other fields are optional and may be absent if the model file does not expose the corresponding metadata. Callers should treat missing fields as unknown rather than assuming a default value.

## Data format
The serialization format of structured data. A value tagged with both a data-format
and a structure tag tells consumers exactly how to parse the bytes into a structured
representation. JSON is the default for cap inter-step data exchange.

JavaScript Object Notation. Text-based, human-readable, ubiquitous. The default
serialization for structured cap inputs and outputs.

## Record marker
Presence marker indicating the value's content is a key-value mapping at its
root: a JSON object, a CSV row with named columns, a TOML table, an INI file.
Independent of `list-marker` — a value can be both (a list of records),
either alone, or neither.

The value's content is a key-value mapping. Consumers can expect to address
fields by name.
